name: infinite-canvas-desktop
description: 无限画布桌面版：内置 Canvas Agent 与本地代理，用户无需安装任何依赖

scripts.resources: npm --prefix ../canvas-agent install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix ../canvas-agent run build && npm --prefix ../canvas-agent prune --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund && bun install --cwd ../web && bun run --cwd ../web build
